name: economist-podcast-studio
description: Vertical-first, source-linked Economist article extraction, conversational podcast scripts, reusable local media, and static-slide video rendering.

interface.longDescription: A vertical-first local production plugin for extracting one selected Economist article, freezing source-bounded conversational scripts and captions, reusing completed media, and rendering the approved 9:16 static-slide podcast video without external APIs when local artifacts are available.
defaultPrompt: Run the vertical-first local Economist article-to-podcast-video workflow.
Extract one selected Economist article from a PDF.
Turn a verified Economist article into a natural podcast script.
Generate the selected podcast audio, captions, and static-slide video.
